notes.title: Demo Patch V0.1.8
notes.content: [p]This week’s patches aren’t much, but they’re honest work. I tried to balance the enemy player dynamic a bit more, especially later in the game.[/p][p]As always, I’m grateful to you for being a part of the commander’s journey🐾[/p][p][/p][h1][b]Enemies[/b][/h1][p][b]Changed enemy spawn behavior[/b]. Enemy spawning has been adjusted so that enemies now appear closer to the player based on the difficulty. Elites are also more likely to spawn nearby, keeping the action tight and the pressure on.[/p][p][/p][p][b]The elite enemy lifebar has been removed.[/b] It often got in the way and wasn’t very useful during the chaos.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Explosive Spikes are now categorized as Elite Enemies.[/b][/p][p][b] [/b][/p][h1][b]Gameplay[/b][/h1][p][b]Multiple Beacons Activation. [/b]I’ve been struggling for a while with letting the player activate multiple beacons at the same time. I was thinking it could be too overpowered. After a few tweaks it is now a more balanced game mechanic. So, I’ve enabled multiple beacon activation![/p][p][/p][p][b]Challenges order rework. [/b]Added a small tweak to the challenges system so that the same challenge can’t appear twice in a row.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Added collect Resources Challenge. [/b]I have added a challenge where you need to collect a certain amount of resources.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Added Don’t Fire Challenge. [/b]I have added a challenge where you need to hold your fire until the timer runs out.[/p][p] [/p][h1][b]Miscellaneous[/b][/h1][p][b]Exploding buildings/beacons damage changed.[/b] I’ve lowered the damage dealt by exploding buildings and beacons. They were great for clearing out the map, but ended up being a little too punishing for the player.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Exploding buildings projectiles patched.[/b] Fixed an issue where projectiles from exploding buildings were dealing damage over time instead of instant damage.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Fixed a visual issue with Amplifier and Protection Beacon Cards ability.[/b] If you were in multiple beacons previously, their power stacked correctly, but the icon would disappear when leaving one beacon. This is now fixed, and the icons accurately reflect the active effects.[/p]

notes.title: Demo Patch V0.1.7
notes.content: [p]Pss, pss! Little pawrrior, I have some patches for you![/p][p]This week patches have been focused mainly on balancing the upgrade Cards. Let me know what you think!🐾[/p][p][/p][h1][b]Abilities[/b][/h1][p][b]New Ability[/b] [b]Purriodic Healing[/b]. Heal every second for a period of time.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Orbital Laser[/b] [b]Ability:[/b] improved targeting.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Orbital Laser[/b] [b]Ability:[/b] cooldown visual fix.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Shrubbery Ability improved.[/b] The ability effect now stays on the map after activation for a limited amount of time, so you can create small patches of healing all over the map.[/p][p][/p][h1]Cards[/h1][p][b]Adjusted drop chance for Energy Upgrade Card.[/b] Energy upgrade cards are now more common in the packs.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Corrosive Bullets Card. [/b]The effect chance has been increased from 10% to 15% per card. The upgrade now deals exclusively corrosive damage (it’s not based on your base damage anymore) every second for a total duration of 3 seconds. While the effect is active, the corroded enemy takes 50% more damage.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Defensive Support Card.[/b] Increased multiplier from 25% to 75%.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Decrease Recoil Card.[/b] Its effect has been increased from 2.5% to 15%.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Electric Bullets Card. [/b]The effect chance has been doubled from 10% to 20% per card. The upgrade now deals exclusively electrical damage (it’s not based on your base damage anymore) every 2 seconds for a total duration of 10 seconds. It now also spawns one electric arc, with each shock, that deals half the electrical damage to surrounding enemies.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Flaming Bullets Card. [/b]The effect chance has been increased from 10% to 15% per card. The upgrade now deals exclusively fire damage (it’s not based on your base damage anymore) every second for a total duration of 3 seconds. If a burning enemy dies, it leaves a fire patch on the ground.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Increased Damage Card.[/b] Its damage bonus has been increased from 25% to 85%. The recoil debuff has also been increased from 5% to 10%.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Increased Heavy Ordnance Card.[/b] Its damage bonus has been increased from 20% to 50%.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Increased Offensive Support Card.[/b] Increased multiplier from 25% to 75%.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Increased Perpetual Motion Card.[/b] Its effect has been increased from 5% to 10%.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Increased Hull Upgrade Card. [/b]Its effect has been increased from +50HP to +100HP. The speed debuff has also been increased from 5% to 7.5%.[/p][p][/p][p][b]NEW Card ROF Support Units. [/b]This card increases the rate of fire of your support units by 25%.[/p][p][/p][p][b]NEW Card Turret Ammunition. [/b]This card increases the ammo pool of your turrets by 75%.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Improved Shield Card[/b]. The Shield card text has been improved for clarity. It now explicitly states that while the shield is active, you cannot take damage from piercing projectiles (such as mini spikes, exploding spikes projectiles, or swarm projectiles). The debuff of no healing while shielded has been replaced by a debuff of 30%, per card, less efficient healing while shielded.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Clarified Weak Point Card text.[/b] Text has been improved to clarify that all damage to buildings (from the player, the environment, or enemies) is increased.[/p][p][/p][h1][b]Enemy Cards[/b][/h1][p][b]Shorter Agony Amplifier activation time. [/b]The agony amplifier card time has been shortened from 2 minutes to 1 minute.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Shorter Tech Shield activation time. [/b]The tech shield card time has been shortened from 2 minutes to 1 minute.[/p][p][/p][h1][b]Enemies[/b][/h1][p][b]Changed Cannon Corvettes[/b]. The ships that fire five shots in succession, now shoot all shots in a straight line instead of tracking the player.[/p][p][/p][p][b]NEW enemy the Flak Cannon[/b]. A new cheesy enemy type has been released to the battlefield. The mozzarella Flak Cannon is an enemy that fires 5 projectiles, at the same time in an arch, 3 times in a row.[/p][p][/p][h1][b]Gameplay[/b][/h1][p][b]Card stacking.[/b] Fixed issues with card stacking. Certain combinations were producing unintended results, sometimes increasing stats instead of decreasing them. The code was calculated, but man I’m bad at math![/p][p][/p][p][b]Projectiles weapon.[/b] The starting damage of projectiles has been lowered from 10 to 5.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Player spawn[/b]. Switched from a random spawn to a fixed one. You now always spawn in the middle of the map.[/p][p][/p][p][b]More ammo to Turrets.[/b] Turrets now start with 150 ammo pool instead of 100.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Turrets ammo indicator. [/b]The line division of the activation/range area now also indicates the amount of bullets left.[/p][p][/p][h1]Miscellaneous[/h1][p][b]Guardian death[/b] now features additional effects and a small stinger, with explosions sound concurrency removed for a more engaging audio experience.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Tutorial. [/b]Fixed a bug where if you chose to recycle your Ability Module. The tutorial would not show you the end text and thus, you would not know that the tutorial ended.[/p][p][/p][h1]UI[/h1][p][b]Upgrade Packs. [/b]Fixed a visual issue when opening packs after a reroll. Larger packs now correctly display their VFX after rerolling from a small pack.[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Demo Patch V0.1.6
notes.content: [p]Patch, scratch, patch, scratch… or was it the other way around? Either way, today brings major gameplay improvements and quality-of-life updates! The Commander and I have been listening to your feedback, and this patch addresses many of your ideas and suggestions.[/p][p]What are you waiting for? Clawsome adventures await you !!! 🐾[/p][p][/p][h1]Cards[/h1][p][b]New card added “Delayed Deactivation”.[/b] This card increases the time before a beacon begins deactivating by 100%, giving you more time to return back into the beacon and continue activating it.[/p][p][/p][p][b]“Weak Point”card[/b] has been moved to the Tech Cards Pack.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Reroll rework.[/b] Reroll now opens a completely new random pack, so if you reroll from a simple white pack, you can get lucky and get a golden (double choice) pack.[/p][p][/p][h1]Gameplay[/h1][p][b]Combo System Revamp[/b]. The old percentage-based multiplier has been replaced with a more accurate counter that shows exactly how many enemies you’ve taken down. When playing as Commander Cookie, her special ability still grants a 1.5x bonus per kill.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Enhanced Homing Missiles[/b]. Homing missiles are now more accurate.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Guardian Destruction Overhaul[/b]. Taking down a Guardian now feels more impactful, with improved visuals and effects to make the moment more satisfying.[/p][p][/p][h1]UI[/h1][p][b]New Map Feature. [/b]A map has been added to the bottom-right corner of your HUD, letting you see your surroundings and track points of interest at a glance.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Bigger Enemy Pack Ability Timer[/b]. The timelines for enemy pack cards are now bigger, making it easier to see when their effects will expire. They are still located in the upper-right corner just below the difficulty indicator.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Bigger Resource Meter[/b]. The resources meter has been enlarged for clearer visibility. It is still located on the upper-left corner just above your health bar.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Bigger Combo meter[/b]. The meter and its information have been slightly enlarged.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Combo meter visual fix[/b]. The meter now updates correctly when it fills above the highest ability slot/level.[/p][p][/p][h1]Miscellaneous[/h1][p][b]New music menu. [/b]The main menu features a new track.[/p][p][/p][h1]Major Update[/h1][p][b]Tutorial Level Added. [/b]A brand-new tutorial level lets you learn the core gameplay mechanics. Perfect for both new and returning players![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45662487/9eb9c1918074d327699a45227451f015312e83aa.png"][/img][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Demo Patch V0.1.5
notes.content: [p]Patch day is here, and this one’s all about the little things that make life smoother.[/p][p]As always, your support means the world. You’re the cat’s whiskers![/p][p] [/p][p]Meow for now😺![/p][p][/p][h1]Cards[/h1][p][b]“Discharge” card[/b] [b]effect adjusted.[/b] It now takes into account the number of shields you have. The more shields you have, the larger the explosion and the higher the damage when they’re all depleted.[/p][p][/p][h1]Gameplay[/h1][p][b]Guardian Level timer.[/b] It used to count how long you survived. Changed the timer to show time remaining until the Guardian spawns. [/p][p][/p][h1]Miscellaneous[/h1][p][b]Temporarily removed the Arcade Filter Mode. [/b]The Arcade Filter has been disabled due to a bug where clickable areas no longer align correctly with the visual buttons. This issue is enhanced on unusual screen resolutions and when Windows display scaling is enabled. The feature will return once a reliable fix is implemented.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Added a Replay Button at the end of a round. [/b]It allows you to instantly restart the round without returning to the main menu.[/p][p][/p][p][b]First choice now preselected in the Choices Menu. [/b]The choices menu now automatically highlights the first option by default, so you can fight those pesky mice even faster.[/p]

notes.title: Demo Patch V0.1.4
notes.content: [p]Ready for your weekly treats? It’s patch time😊[/p][p]Thank you for your support and feedback. Meow you later 😺![/p][p][/p][h1]Cards[/h1][p][b]Increased “Tractor Beam” card efficiency. Increased pickup range bonus[/b] from[b] 35% to 75%.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]New Tech limited-edition card “Loot Linger”. [/b]Grants up to[b] +200% pickup lifespan [/b]when fully stacked.[/p][p][/p][p][b]New Enemy Card “Cursed Magnet”.[/b] Grants a temporary pickup range increase of 500% but also significantly increases enemy presence on the map.[/p][p][/p][h1]Gameplay[/h1][p][b]Removed force feedback when not playing with the gamepad. [/b]Your gamepad will not vibrate anymore if you are playing with mouse and keyboard, even if the gamepad is connected and active.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Added an extra out of bounds[/b] [b]visual indicator. Next to the existing visual effects, I added a HUD indicator that[/b] displays the remaining time before taking damage when out of bounds.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Fixed a bug[/b] where the “Meowmentum” card caused the out of bounds visual effects to persist after returning within the city walls.[/p][p][/p][h1]Performance[/h1][p][b]Optimized Explosive Spike enemies.[/b] Adjusted their behavior and attack logic to improve performance.[/p]

notes.title: Demo Patch V0.1.3
notes.content:
[p]It’s our weekly patch time! I value your feedback so I’ve been busy implementing it in the latest updates.[/p][p][/p][p]Purrrr on!😺![/p][p][/p][h1]Cards[/h1][p][b]“Finite Feast” card now displays the correct description.
[/b] Card now reads: [b][i]Temporarily[/i][/b][i] sacrifice 30% of your maximum health. Each kill restores 5 health...[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]Removed reload debuff from “ROF” card.
[/b]Increasing your rate of fire no longer comes with a reload speed penalty.[/p][p][/p][h1]Gameplay[/h1][p][b]Added a spread and fire direction indicator. [/b]It also shines when you fire.[/p][p][/p][h1]Miscellaneous[/h1][p][b]Main menu placeholder track has now been replaced! [/b]Thanks for the feedback on the placeholder track. As discussed, I only had the track in the demo in order to gather your feedback. When the game becomes profitable and I finish the lyrics, I will record the full song with an artist and bring it back properly.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Balanced music asset volume. [/b]All music tracks now share the same base volume.[/p]

notes.title: Demo Patch V0.1.2
notes.content: [p]Patch time! A week has passed since the demo launch and I am thankful for all the feedback and insights you have shared! As a reward, here is a can of delicious patches 😺![/p][p]Game on and keep me posted! [/p][p][/p][h1]Cards[/h1][p][b]Adjusted conditions for the Elemental Damage card.[/b] It will not be included in your deck if you don’t have any elemental damage attributes applied. [/p][p][/p][p][b]Resolved layout problems with rich text at non-HD resolutions.[/b] Below 1080p, some text overlapped, while above it, spacing between words became inconsistent or too wide.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Fixed a bug with “Perpetual Motion” cards.[/b] Stacking too many caused the reload stat to go negative, resulting in slower reloads instead of faster ones.[/p][p][/p][h1]Beacons[/h1][p][b]Enemy card beacons now have a despawn timer.[/b] You have 3 minutes to activate them, during which their activation range steadily decreases.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Charging areas now light up during activation[/b], making it easier to see which beacon is being powered.[/p][p][/p][h1]Performance[/h1][p][b]Modified a few background processes [/b]in order to optimize performance.[/p]

notes.title: Demo Patch V0.1.1
notes.content:
[p]I’ve gone through your feedback like a curious cat in a storage room and looked closely at how some systems scale and interact. This patch scratches at the core gameplay and pounces on early game balance issues to make things smoother and more satisfying. [/p][p]Thanks for playing and keep the feedback coming![/p][p][/p][h1]Cards[/h1][p][b]Increased spawn probability for:[/b][/p][list][*][p]"More Weapons"[/p][/*][*][p]"Projectile Split"[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Adjusted conditions for the Support cards "Defensive" and "Offensive".[/b] They will not be included in your deck if you don’t have at least one Support unit. [/p][p]
[b]Players now start with 2 standard rerolls.[/b] Additional rerolls can still be obtained as before, by RECYCLING (discarding) Multiplier Modules.[/p][p][/p][h1]Multiplier Modules[/h1][p][b]Improved module stat scaling based on multiplier slots and resource amounts.[/b] The difference in stats between lower and higher multiplier slots is now more significant across all affected module attributes. Additionally, the amount of corresponding resources has a greater impact, resulting in better scaling for each related stat as more resources are gathered.[/p][p][/p][h1]Player[/h1][p]Decreased Energy Furball (weapon) base recoil by 40%.[/p][p][/p][h1]Enemies[/h1][p][b]Adjusted difficulty curve.[/b] Enemies now spawn less frequently in the first 4 levels to allow for a more balanced early game experience. [/p][p][/p][p][b]Adjusted elite enemy drops:[/b][/p][list][*][p] Increased the number of drops based on enemy health. The larger the health pool, the more items they drop.[/p][/*][*][p] Decreased the chance for elite enemies to drop one of the three main resources (Tech, Armory, Defence).[/p][/*][*][p] Increased the chance of higher value drops, containing larger amounts of upgrade resources or health pickups.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Game Demo
notes.content:
[p][/p][p]Excited to share the [b]first public demo[/b] of The Odyssey of Commander Cookie! 😼  [/p][p]This early version gives you a taste of the gameplay, world, and mechanics I have been working on.[/p][p][/p][p][b]What to Expect:[/b][/p][p]A simplified version of the full game. You’ll play a single level and fight only one of the bosses, with no access to character, ship, or weapon selection. Everything else is just as you'd experience it in the full game. Please note this is an early version and may contain bugs.[/p][p][/p][p][b]I would love your feedback![/b]
Your input is incredibly valuable and will help me shape the future of the game. Do you have any feedback or just want to hang out? Join the Commander on her bridge on her very own [url="https://discord.gg/2CfnVVwHKD"]Discord server[/url].[/p][p][/p][p]Wishlist it, share it, stream it, tell your friends, but most of all, [b]have fun:[/b][/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3845570/The_Odyssey_of_Commander_Cookie_Demo/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Meow you later 🐾,[/p][p]Nethro Interactive[/p]
